name: firecrawl-mcp
description: MCP server for Firecrawl — search, scrape, and interact with the web. Supports both cloud and self-hosted instances. Features include web search, scraping, page interaction, batch processing, and LLM-powered content analysis.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.mjs tests/contract/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:hosted-auth: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern "hosted OAuth audience gate" tests/mcp-smoke.test.mjs
scripts.test:packed: npm run build && npm run check:third-party-notices && node scripts/verify-packed-package.mjs
scripts.publish-prod: npm run build && npm run check:third-party-notices && npm publish
scripts.publish-beta: npm run build && npm run check:third-party-notices && npm publish --tag beta

author: firecrawl
